capabilities: Export the current note as paginated PNG pages
Export the note as a single long image
Apply body layout templates with page thumbnails
Add a customizable cover with title, author, word count and reading time
Load images from vault attachments or HTTP(S) links
disambiguation: It does not create paginated notes inside the vault; it exports the note as PNG page images or one long image file.
extras: The manifest description also claims export to a Word document with images for Zhihu import, which the README does not document. Not yet listed in the community directory at the time of writing ("上架后"). Remote HTTP(S) images require network access; local-only notes export offline. Very long notes are scaled down proportionally, with pagination as the fallback. Running npm test needs Chrome, unzip and a Chinese font.
intentEvidence: 如果已手动安装早期的「长文一键出图」（publish-picture）
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a finished note into page images or a single long image suitable for posting outside the vault.

relations.evidence: 先在同一个笔记库停用旧插件，再安装并启用「Draft to Pages」

requires.name: Node.js 22 and npm, only to build from source

summary: Exporter that turns the current Markdown note and its images into paginated 2160×2880 PNGs or one long image, with an optional cover page.
